title: CDN Asset Metadata
description: Metadata for media assets (H.264 instructional video clips and anatomical SVG muscle heatmaps) hosted on the LeanHome CDN (Cloudflare R2 / S3 at https://cdn.leanhome.app). Every catalog exercise is served from a stable path: the looping demonstration video at https://cdn.leanhome.app/exercises/{exercise_id}/video.mp4 and the fallback anatomical diagram at https://cdn.leanhome.app/exercises/{exercise_id}/diagram.svg. The local cache key for any asset is the SHA-256 hash (hex lowercase) of its absolute CDN URL.

cdn_base_url.description: Origin serving all LeanHome media assets.

video_path_template.description: Absolute CDN URL template for the looping instructional video. {exercise_id} is replaced with the catalog exercise slug (regex ^[a-z0-9_]+$).

svg_path_template.description: Absolute CDN URL template for the offline fallback anatomical SVG muscle heatmap. {exercise_id} is replaced with the catalog exercise slug (regex ^[a-z0-9_]+$).

cache_key_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used to derive the on-device cache file name. The cache key is the SHA-256 hex digest of the absolute CDN URL string (UTF-8 no trailing slash, exactly as fetched).

cache_key_encoding.description: The 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 digest forms the cache file name (e.g. <key>.mp4).

default_cache_ceiling_bytes.description: Default LRU video cache ceiling of 500 MB (500 * 1024 * 1024 = 524,288,000 bytes) enforced on both Android and iOS.

video_assets.description: One video asset entry per catalog exercise. Each video is encoded H.264 (AVC) + AAC audio at 720p 30fps with target CRF 26 and average 1.5-3 MB per ~10 second looping set.

svg_assets.description: One SVG anatomical heatmap entry per catalog exercise, used as offline fallback when the video is not cached. The SVG must highlight primary muscle groups with high-contrast coloring and show starting and ending body positions.

id.description: Stable asset id prefixed with 'video_' followed by the exercise slug.

exercise_id.description: Foreign key to exercises.id. The CDN directories are sharded by this id.

url.description: Absolute CDN URL of the H.264 mp4. Matches video_path_template after {exercise_id} substitution.

codec.description: Video codec. Default transcoding target is H.264 (AVC) for maximum device compatibility.

resolution.description: Display resolution tier. Default delivered tier is 720p (1280x720).

bitrate.description: Average video bitrate in bits per second.

file_size_bytes.description: Exact byte length of the encoded mp4. Used to verify integrity against the SHA-256 cache key and to budget cache eviction.

checksum_md5.description: MD5 digest (hex lowercase) of the raw video file bytes, used for CDN-side integrity verification against corrupted re-encodes. On-device integrity reuses the SHA-256 cache key.

id.description: Stable SVG asset id prefixed with 'svg_' followed by the exercise slug.

url.description: Absolute CDN URL of the SVG. Matches svg_path_template after {exercise_id} substitution.

primary_muscles_highlighted.description: Subset of the exercise primary_muscles emphasized in the heatmap. Must reference the canonical muscle enum used by the exercise schema so the iOS/Android renderers can share color mapping.

format.description: Vector illustration format. Always 'svg' for the fallback heatmap.
